verdict.rationale: Gemini CLI lets users configure which MCP servers/tools are enabled via ~/.gemini/settings.json, giving some control over external integrations, and mentions vague 'Enterprise features: Advanced security and compliance.' However there's no documented allow/deny policy, per-tool permission gating, or centralized admin control mechanism specifically for an engineering-lead to restrict team-wide tool access. Missing for 10: explicit permission/allowlist system, org-level policy enforcement, and independent confirmation that access controls work as intended.
